claim.claim-text: 2. The child stroller frame (100) according to claim 1, wherein the child stroller frame (100) is folded either with the handle frame segment (11) and the front leg segment (12) lying at one same side of the second frame portion (2), or with the handle frame segment (11) and the front leg segment (12) respectively lying at two opposite sides of the second frame portion (2).

3. The child stroller frame (100) according to claim 1 or 2, wherein the second frame portion (2) has a front end pivotally connected with the front leg segment (12), and a rear end pivotally connected with the pivoting part (3).

4. The child stroller frame (100) according to claim 1 or 2, wherein the second frame portion (2) has a front end pivotally connected with the coupling part (13), and the first end of the linkage (5) is pivotally connected with the front leg segment (12) or the handle frame segment (11).
5. The child stroller frame (100) according to any of claims 1 to 4, wherein the linkage (5) includes:

a first bar assembly (51) respectively connected pivotally with the pivoting part (3) and the second frame portion (2), the first bar assembly (51) including a first bar (511) pivotally connected with the second frame portion (2); and a second bar assembly (52) respectively connected pivotally with the first bar (511) and the first frame portion (1).

6. The child stroller frame (100) according to claim 5, wherein the first bar assembly (51) includes a second bar (512) having two opposite ends respectively connected pivotally with the first bar (511) and the pivoting part (3).

7. The child stroller frame (100) according to claim 6, wherein the first bar (511) has a first and a second bar portion (5111, 5112), the first bar (511) being pivotally connected with the second bar assembly (52) at an end of the first bar portion (5111), and the second bar portion (5112) extending toward and pivotally connecting with the second bar (512).

8. The child stroller frame (100) according to claim 7, wherein the first and second bar portions (5111, 5112) intersect each other at an angle, a pivot connection between the first bar (511) and the second frame portion (2) being located at a joining region between the first and second bar portions (5111, 5112).
9. The child stroller frame (100) according to claim 7 or 8, wherein the first bar (511) has a L-shape.

10. The child stroller frame (100) according to claim 7, 8 or 9, further including a limiting structure (53) disposed between the first bar portion (5111) and the second bar assembly (52), the first bar portion (5111) and the second bar assembly (52) forming a substantially straight shape that extends between the first frame portion (1) and the second frame portion (2) when the child stroller frame (100) is in an unfolded state for use.

11. The child stroller frame (100) according to any one of claims 6 to 10, wherein the second bar (512) has a shape (5121) configured to prevent obstructing interference with the pivoting part (3) and/or the rear wheel support member (4) during folding movement.
12. The child stroller frame (100) according to claim 11, wherein the second bar (512) includes a curved profile with a concavity facing downward.

13. The child stroller frame (100) according to any one of claims 5 to 12, wherein the second bar assembly (52) includes a third bar (521) having two opposite ends respectively connected pivotally with the first bar (511) and the first frame portion (1).
14. The child stroller frame (100) according to any one of claims 1 to 13, wherein the rear wheel support member (4) includes a transversal axle or a wheel mount.
